_doc: Constructed fist, 144 px, ROUND 2 (glaive-hands lane; author_hands.py; the round-1 template is fist_144.json). Same canonical frame as round 1: the haft vertical through haft_cols (tip up), the thumb end at the top, the knuckles on the LEFT, the forearm entering from the RIGHT. Critique round 1 (6. Arms and hands): the fist read as 'mostly mid-tone o pixels with about 8 scattered skin pixels: no knuckle line, no thumb wedge'. Round 2 builds it from FEW, LARGE value groups: a 2 px lit knuckle ridge (r, S1) running along the haft; the knuckle line (l, S3/S4) under it bowing 1 px toward the knuckle edge in the middle (HD-P02: middle knuckle highest); the finger strip beyond it (k, S3 palm-side shadow) notched by 1-2 finger separations (n, S4; HD-N02); the back of the hand (b, S2) with its far edge turning away (B, S3); the thumb wedge (t lit, T underside) crossing the haft on the near side at the thumb end with a 1 px crease (c, S4) under it; the pinky end (d, S3); O = OL everywhere in round 2 (the 1 px dark separator the critique asked for; S4 contact lines merged the fist into the white cuff and the skin); w = the wrist running on into the forearm (the 1 px wrist step is the notch where the box edge meets the w rows). fingers view: the curled fingers to the viewer as stacked rolls across the haft (f lit top of a roll, e the tucked fingertip end, n the separation between rolls), the thumb across the top. 9 across (+ the wrist column) x 8 along.
